categories.main_business_segments: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. (ARE) operates primarily as a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on owning, operating, and developing collaborative life science, agtech, and technology campuses. The company’s business is centered on Class A properties in key innovation clusters, with a single reportable segment encompassing property ownership, development, redevelopment, and selective acquisitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: ARE specializes in the development and redevelopment of high-quality, generic, and reusable office/laboratory, agtech, and tech office spaces. Properties are designed with advanced infrastructure such as reinforced concrete floors, upgraded HVAC, enhanced environmental controls, and robust electrical and plumbing systems to meet the needs of life science and technology tenants. The company targets LEED Gold or Platinum certification for new ground-up developments and incorporates sustainability and wellness features.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ARE’s key customers include multinational pharmaceutical companies, public and private biotechnology firms, life science product and medical device companies, digital health and agtech companies, academic and medical research institutions, U.S. government research agencies, non-profits, and venture capital firms. The company serves approximately 1,000 tenants, with a focus on organizations engaged in scientific and technological innovation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in major North American innovation clusters: Greater Boston, San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, San Diego, Seattle, Maryland, and Research Triangle, with additional properties in Texas, Canada, and China. As of December 31, 2022, ARE owned or managed 432 properties totaling over 47 million rentable square feet.
categories.supply_chain_position: ARE operates downstream in the real estate supply chain, providing finished, specialized office/laboratory and tech spaces to end users in the life science, agtech, and technology sectors. The company acts as a landlord and developer, delivering turnkey facilities and campus environments to its tenants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, ARE focuses on maximizing long-term asset value and shareholder returns through internal and external growth, disciplined capital allocation, and a unique emphasis on Class A properties in high-barrier-to-entry innovation clusters. The company invests in sustainability, wellness, and operational efficiency, and maintains a venture capital platform to support transformative companies in life science, agtech, and technology. R&D efforts are directed at developing state-of-the-art, flexible, and sustainable campuses.
categories.revenue_model: ARE generates revenue primarily through rental income from long-term leases, with approximately 93% of leases being triple net (tenants pay most operating expenses). Additional revenue streams include tenant recoveries, capital recapture, and strategic investments in venture capital. The company also benefits from annual rent escalations and recapture of certain capital expenditures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ARE competes with other REITs, institutional investors, private equity, developers, and owners/occupants for both tenants and property acquisitions. Its main competitors include other office/laboratory and technology property owners in innovation clusters. ARE differentiates itself as the first and leading publicly traded life science REIT, with a reputation for high-quality, collaborative campuses and strong industry relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, ARE had a total market capitalization of $35.0 billion, an asset base of 74.6 million square feet, and annual revenues of $2.6 billion (up 22.5% year-over-year). The company reported net income attributable to common stockholders of $513 million and funds from operations (FFO) of $1.36 billion. ARE has demonstrated strong internal growth, high occupancy (94.8%), and a robust development pipeline.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ARE’s value proposition lies in its ability to provide best-in-class, mission-driven, and collaborative campus environments in AAA innovation clusters, tailored to the needs of life science, agtech, and technology tenants. The company emphasizes high-quality, sustainable, and flexible spaces that support tenant productivity, talent recruitment, and innovation, resulting in high occupancy, long lease terms, and stable cash flows. Its integrated venture capital platform and ESG leadership further differentiate ARE in the market.
